ordering: GPU processes and builds serialized; final native campaign uses final code. Diagnostic failures are excluded from pass counts.
native_profile: object/weighted OIT x DPR 1/2; BGFX Vulkan/OpenGL and wgpu Vulkan; AMD backend with NVIDIA GLX oracle. BGFX program cache explicitly disabled.
mips_profile: staged RGBA8 POT; 7 quality transitions per route/mechanism, 4 minified RGB comparisons against native CoinGL; NPOT rejection and recovery on each transition; quality off/reactivation; FBO and pbuffer.
diagnostics: Isolated Xwayland session could not create the CoinGL offscreen reference; desktop NVIDIA oracle passes counted separately.
Initial wgpu window rejection fell back because its surface serial was missing in the C++ wrapper; corrected and final matrix repeated.

The initial RTT profile test ignored renderer environment because of explicit default options; OpenGL-labelled offscreen RTT was actually Vulkan. Test options now read diagnostics shell configuration, and mip/RTT gates were repeated with actual OpenGL context proof.
First resize serial reset invalidated same-size redraws; no-op window resize fixed, CPU guard and final matrix repeated.
